description: CSV / TSV to JSON (RFC 4180 quoting, delimiter auto-detect, type inference). Parses CSV with quoted fields, embedded newlines and doubled quotes; auto-detects comma, semicolon, tab or pipe. Returns an array of objects (using the header row) or of arrays, optionally inferring numbers, booleans and nulls. Up to 50,000 rows. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
